decisions.decision: A real 0.0 tyre delta renders NO icon but still prints its numeric line ('0.0 vs prev. day'). A nil delta prints no line at all. No third neutral glyph is added.
decisions.why: User picked it from three options. The numeric line already tells 'no change' apart from 'unknown', so a new glyph in the shared ui/ kit is not worth the blast radius.

decisions.decision: Tier 4 touches no database object, so the built-in database design gate does not apply. It reads the same precomputed row tier 3 already widened.
decisions.why: The gate exists for schema changes. Recording the check so a reviewer sees it was made, not skipped.

events.detail: Tier 4 artifacts created and validated with openspec validate --strict. Worker confirmed it reuses tier 2's real ui.StatTileProps.Trend and the trending_up/trending_down Icon glyphs, not a second trend mechanism. No database change, so no design gate. One decision the roadmap did not cover went to the user: the 0.0-delta rendering (D-zero-delta).
Wave 1 dispatched: one serial gateway worker on Sonnet for T1 (formatters + view model + mapping), T2 (i18n) and T3 (panel layout). Budget at start: five_hour 31%, context 20%.

Wave 1 done. Worker read the full doc pack and enumerated D1-D10. The leader independently verified RD14 in handlers.go: dashTireTrend returns "" for nil and for 0.0, while dashTireDelta returns "" only for nil. So a real zero shows its number with no arrow, and an unknown shows neither. Pre-existing gofmt drift in vehicle_image_test.go confirmed untouched by this change. Budget: five_hour 31%->49%.
Wave 2 dispatched: T4 (view-model tests against the Test Contract) and T5 (AGENTS.md + two KB files). Sandbox widened to the two named KB files. Budget at start: five_hour 49%, context 21%.

Wave 2 done. Leader spot-checked the load-bearing assertion in handlers_test.go: the real-zero wheel asserts Trend "" with Delta "0.0 vs prev. day", the absent wheel asserts both empty. That is RD14. Leader ran T6: build, vet, ui-guard, i18n-guard, archive-guard, boundary-guard all clean, and re-running templ/css left no diff. Tests are written but NOT run. Status applied, not verified, until the owner reports the suite.
